claims.text: Clinician note records Glucophage 850 mg twice daily continues and that HbA1c is improving.
Staff note records that the pharmacy list shows metformin 500 mg twice daily.

citations.quote: Pharmacy list shows metformin 500 mg twice daily.

open_questions: The record contains conflicting names and doses for the same medication — Glucophage 850 mg twice daily in the clinician note versus metformin 500 mg twice daily on the pharmacy list; which is the current regimen?
When was metformin first recorded and at what dose, and was it ever changed to or from Glucophage 850 mg twice daily? Earlier entries documenting this are not present.
What earlier entries document the HbA1c trend and prior values? No prior HbA1c values are available in the record.
Was the pharmacy list metformin 500 mg discrepancy previously noted or reconciled? No earlier record addresses this.
Are any allergies or reactions recorded in earlier entries? No allergy information appears in the record.
Are there earlier entries documenting renal function or other monitoring relevant to metformin? None are available in the record.

citation.quote: Pharmacy list shows metformin 500 mg twice daily.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: The pharmacy list name and dose (metformin 500 mg twice daily) differ from the clinician note (Glucophage 850 mg twice daily), indicating a possible medication reconciliation discrepancy.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Clinician to reconcile the pharmacy list against the clinician note and confirm the current regimen.
